text:
Korea's exports more than doubled during the first 20 days of November, customs data showed Monday.
Outbound shipments reached $77.4 billion in the Nov. 1-20 period, up from $38.4 billion a year ago, according to the data from the Korea Customs Service.
Imports went up 39.4 percent on-year to $50.3 billion over the cited period, resulting in a trade surplus of $27.1 billion.
